'''Planetary Customs Security Checkpoint LH48''' was one of many checkpoints on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aargau/Legends|Aargau]]. It was where [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and Viscount [[Tardi]] passed through while on their mission to secure a loan from the [[Bank of Aargau/Legends|Bank of Aargau]].<ref name="aargau">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030807aargau|text=Aargau: For All Your Banking Needs|int=Aargau: For All Your Banking Needs}}}}</ref>
